name: Disagreement fade (single game)
signal: take the side the two estimators disagree about least in the direction of the consensus, i.e. |E1-E2| small and consensus margin large; the bet is that agreement is information
universe: every game on the published 3-day slate
settlement_rule: against official final margin from nba.com/game/<id>; push if the margin equals our line exactly; graded once and hashed
note: frozen before the first bet; a change to any field above is a NEW strategy with a new id, never an edit to this file
